tools.name: list_guilds
tools.description: List the servers (ID and name) the bot has joined.

tools.name: get_guild_info
tools.description: Show server settings: name, owner, member count, verification level, system/rules channels, features, boost tier.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: edit_guild
tools.description: Change server settings (only the fields you pass). verificationLevel: 0 none, 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high, 4 very high. defaultMessageNotifications: 0 all messages, 1 only mentions. Channel settings take channel IDs. Needs Manage Server.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: list_emojis
tools.description: List custom emojis (ID, name, animated).

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: create_emoji
tools.description: Add a custom emoji from an image URL or local file path (png, jpg, gif, webp; Discord limits the size to 256 KB). Needs Create Expressions.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: delete_emoji
tools.description: Delete a custom emoji.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: list_invites
tools.description: List active invites (code, channel, uses, expiry). Needs Manage Server.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: create_invite
tools.description: Create an invite link for a channel. maxAge in seconds (0 = never expires), maxUses 0 = unlimited.

tools.name: delete_invite
tools.description: Revoke an invite by its code.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List webhooks of a channel, or of the whole server when channelId is omitted. Tokens are not shown. Needs Manage Webhooks.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook in a channel. The returned URL contains a secret token: treat it like a password.

tools.name: execute_webhook
tools.description: Post a message through a webhook (a different name and avatar than the bot). Pass the webhook ID (see list_webhooks): the secret token is fetched here and never shown. Only works for webhooks whose token the bot can read (ones it or its server created). threadId posts into a thread. Mentions do not notify unless allowMentions=true.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List scheduled events (ID, name, start time, status).

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a scheduled event. kind=voice or stage needs channelId. kind=external needs location and endTime. Times are ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-12-01T19:00:00+09:00. Needs Manage Events.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Delete a scheduled event.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: get_audit_log
tools.description: Read recent audit log entries (time, who, action, target, reason). Optional filters: userId, actionType (e.g. ChannelCreate, ChannelDelete, RoleUpdate, MemberKick). Needs View Audit Log.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: get_structure
tools.description: Get categories and channels in display order, with IDs. Call this before reorganizing anything.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: create_category
tools.description: Create a category.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

allowRoles.description: With private: role names allowed to view

tools.name: create_channel
tools.description: Create a channel. Use parentId to place it under a category.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

allowRoles.description: With private: role names allowed to view

tools.name: edit_channel
tools.description: Change a channel or category (only the fields you pass): name, topic, NSFW, parent, slowmode, voice limits, forum tags. Pass an empty string as parentId to remove it from its category. forumTags replaces the tag list by name (existing tags keep their IDs).

tools.name: reorder
tools.description: Change order and parent for many channels at once. position is the 0-based index within the same parent. Discord allows changing the parent of only one channel per call; use edit_channel or apply_layout for several moves.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

parentId.description: Target category. null = no category. Omit to leave unchanged.

tools.name: clone_channel
tools.description: Duplicate a channel or category with its settings and permission overwrites. For a category, withChildren=true also duplicates the channels inside it. The copy is added at the end.

tools.name: get_permissions
tools.description: Show a channel or category's permission overwrites in readable form (role names, allowed and denied permissions).

tools.name: set_permissions
tools.description: Set a role's or member's permission overwrite on a channel or category (replaces that target's existing overwrite). Permission names are discord.js PermissionFlagsBits keys, e.g. ViewChannel, SendMessages, Connect. Use clear_permissions to remove an overwrite.

targetId.description: Role ID or user ID (the @everyone role ID equals the server ID)

tools.name: clear_permissions
tools.description: Remove a target's permission overwrite from a channel or category.

tools.name: sync_permissions
tools.description: Make channels inside a category use the category's permission overwrites (replacing their own). Defaults to dryRun. Pass channelIds to limit which children are synced.

tools.name: delete_channel
tools.description: Delete a channel or category. Messages go with it and cannot be restored. confirmName must exactly match the current name, and the channel must belong to the given server. Take a snapshot first. Deleting a category keeps its channels (they become uncategorized).

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: list_roles
tools.description: List roles (ID and name), highest first. showPermissions adds each role's permission names.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: create_role
tools.description: Create a role. The bot cannot grant permissions it does not have itself.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

permissions.description: Permission names, e.g. ManageMessages. Replaces the role's permissions.

hoist.description: Show members separately in the member list

tools.name: edit_role
tools.description: Change a role (only the fields you pass). permissions replaces the whole permission set.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

permissions.description: Permission names, e.g. ManageMessages. Replaces the role's permissions.

hoist.description: Show members separately in the member list

tools.name: delete_role
tools.description: Delete a role. It is removed from every member. confirmName must exactly match the current name. Take a snapshot first.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: reorder_roles
tools.description: Change role positions. Higher position = higher in the list. The bot can only move roles below its own highest role.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: apply_roles
tools.description: Declare roles and apply them in bulk. Matches existing roles by name: creates missing ones and updates changed fields. Never deletes roles and ignores managed (bot/integration) roles. Defaults to dryRun; a real run saves a snapshot first.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

permissions.description: Permission names, e.g. ManageMessages. Replaces the role's permissions.

hoist.description: Show members separately in the member list

tools.name: search_members
tools.description: Search members by username or nickname prefix. Returns user IDs and their role IDs. Needs the bot to be able to list members.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: add_member_role
tools.description: Give a role to a member.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: remove_member_role
tools.description: Remove a role from a member.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Save the server's current state as JSON: channels, roles, permission overwrites, server settings, emojis, stickers, events, AutoMod rules, onboarding and welcome screen. Parts the bot cannot read are skipped with a note. includeMembers=true also records every member's roles (needs the Server Members Intent). Saved to DISERVERBUILDER_SNAPSHOT_DIR, default ~/.diserverbuilder/snapshots. Use before deletions or large changes. Messages are not included.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: list_snapshots
tools.description: List saved snapshot files (the file name is the server ID plus a timestamp).

tools.name: diff_snapshot
tools.description: Show what changed since a snapshot: roles, channels (incl. permission overwrites), settings, emojis, stickers, events, AutoMod, onboarding. Compares the snapshot with the server's current state, or with a second snapshot (fileB) when given. + added, - removed, ~ changed.

guildId.description: Server to compare against now. Defaults to the snapshot's own server.

file.description: Snapshot file name (from list_snapshots) or absolute path

fileB.description: A later snapshot to compare with, instead of the live server

tools.name: restore_snapshot
tools.description: Recreate roles and channels from a snapshot that are missing in the target server (matched by name or, on the same server, ID). Existing items are never changed or deleted, and messages cannot be restored. Roles are matched by name, so with a different target guildId this copies the structure to another server. include adds optional parts: settings (server settings, channel references mapped), automod (missing rules), emojis (re-downloaded from Discord's CDN), memberRoles (same server only; needs a snapshot taken with includeMembers). Defaults to dryRun.

guildId.description: Target server. Defaults to the snapshot's own server.

file.description: Snapshot file name (from list_snapshots) or absolute path

tools.name: export_layout
tools.description: Export the current categories and channels as JSON in the same shape apply_layout takes: topic, NSFW, slowmode, voice limits, forum tags, permission overwrites by role, and channels outside any category ("uncategorized"). Use it to edit a structure and apply it back, or to reuse it on another server. Member overwrites are skipped unless includeMembers=true (user IDs only make sense on the same server). Unsupported channel types are skipped and listed in the notes, so prune=true would delete them.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: apply_layout
tools.description: Declare the desired structure and apply it in bulk. Matches existing items by name, creates missing ones, moves and updates existing ones (topic, NSFW, slowmode, voice limits, forum tags), and orders everything as given. Include "uncategorized" to manage channels outside any category too. Defaults to dryRun (shows the plan only; an unchanged server reports "Nothing to change"). Channels not in the layout are deleted only when prune=true and dryRun=false (a snapshot is saved automatically before a real run). private/allowRoles/overwrites/memberOverwrites apply to newly created items; set syncPermissions=merge to also add them to existing items (declared bits win, everything else stays) or replace to make existing role overwrites match exactly (undeclared role overwrites are removed, member overwrites stay).

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

allowRoles.description: With private: roles (name or ID) allowed to view
With private: roles (name or ID) allowed to view

uncategorized.description: Channels outside any category, in order

allowRoles.description: With private: roles (name or ID) allowed to view

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a channel as the bot: text, embeds, a poll, and/or link buttons (buttons that open a URL; other kinds cannot work without a gateway connection). replyToMessageId makes it a reply. Mentions do not notify unless allowMentions=true. Optionally pin it.

allowMentions.description: Allow @everyone/@role/@user mentions to notify. Default false.

tools.name: edit_message
tools.description: Edit a message the bot sent. Replaces content and embeds with what you pass.

allowMentions.description: Allow @everyone/@role/@user mentions to notify. Default false.

tools.name: delete_message
tools.description: Delete a message. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: pin_message
tools.description: Pin or unpin a message.

tools.name: get_messages
tools.description: Read recent messages in a channel, newest first (ID, author, text). Needs Read Message History.

before.description: Message ID to read older messages from

tools.name: add_reaction
tools.description: Add a reaction to a message as the bot. Needs Add Reactions and Read Message History.

emoji.description: A unicode emoji, or name:id for a custom emoji

tools.name: remove_reaction
tools.description: Remove reactions from a message. With emoji and no userId: the bot's own reaction. With emoji and userId: that user's. With emoji and all=true: everyone's reaction of that emoji. With only all=true: every reaction on the message (needs Manage Messages).

emoji.description: A unicode emoji, or name:id for a custom emoji

tools.name: purge_messages
tools.description: Delete many messages at once. Looks at the newest `scan` messages (up to 500), keeps those matching the filters, and deletes them. Discord only bulk-deletes messages under 14 days old; older matches are reported and left. Pinned messages are kept unless includePinned. Needs Manage Messages. Defaults to dryRun (counts only). Deleted messages cannot be restored.

contains.description: Case-insensitive text the message must contain

tools.name: create_forum_post
tools.description: Create a post (thread) in a forum channel with its first message. Tags are given by name and must already exist (see edit_channel forumTags). Needs Send Messages (Create Posts) in the forum. Mentions do not notify.

pin.description: Pin the post to the top of the forum (needs Manage Threads)

autoArchiveMinutes.description: Inactivity before the post is archived. Default 10080 (7 days).

tools.name: create_thread
tools.description: Create a thread in a text or announcement channel. Pass messageId to start it from that message, otherwise it is a public thread not tied to a message. For forum channels use create_forum_post. Needs Create Public Threads.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List threads (forum posts) of one channel, or every active thread in the server if channelId is omitted. Set archived=true to list archived threads of channelId instead (newest first, up to limit).

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: edit_thread
tools.description: Change a thread or forum post (only the fields you pass): rename, archive/unarchive, lock/unlock, pin in the forum, set tags by name (replaces the tags). Archiving, locking and pinning need Manage Threads.

tools.name: set_forum_options
tools.description: Change forum channel behaviour (only the fields you pass): require a tag on every post, post sort order, default layout, and the default auto-archive time of posts. Tags themselves are edited with edit_channel forumTags.

tools.name: get_member
tools.description: Show one member: names, roles, join date, timeout, nickname.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: list_role_members
tools.description: List the members who have a role (name or ID). Needs the Server Members Intent turned on for the bot in the Developer Portal.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: kick_member
tools.description: Kick a member from the server. They can rejoin with an invite. Needs Kick Members and a role above the member's.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

reason.description: Shown in the server's audit log

tools.name: ban_member
tools.description: Ban a user (they need not be in the server). deleteMessageSeconds also deletes their recent messages (0 to 604800 = 7 days). Needs Ban Members and a role above the member's.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

reason.description: Shown in the server's audit log

tools.name: unban_member
tools.description: Lift a ban.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

reason.description: Shown in the server's audit log

tools.name: list_bans
tools.description: List bans (user, reason), 1000 at most per call. Pass after (a user ID from the last row) for the next page.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: timeout_member
tools.description: Time a member out (they cannot talk, react or join voice) for the given minutes, up to 28 days (40320). minutes=0 lifts the timeout. Needs Moderate Members.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

reason.description: Shown in the server's audit log

tools.name: set_nickname
tools.description: Change a member's nickname (empty string clears it). Use userId "@me" for the bot itself. Needs Manage Nicknames.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

reason.description: Shown in the server's audit log

tools.name: move_member
tools.description: Move a member who is in a voice channel to another voice channel, or disconnect them (channelId omitted). Needs Move Members.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

channelId.description: Target voice channel. Omit to disconnect.

tools.name: list_automod_rules
tools.description: List AutoMod rules (name, ID, trigger, on/off, actions). Needs Manage Server.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: create_automod_rule
tools.description: Create an AutoMod rule. trigger: keyword (keywords/regexPatterns), spam, keyword_preset (presets), mention_spam (mentionLimit), member_profile (keywords/regexPatterns in names and bios). At least one action is needed: blockMessage/customMessage, alertChannelId, timeoutMinutes (keyword and mention_spam only), blockMemberInteraction (member_profile only). A server may have 6 keyword rules and 1 of each other kind. Needs Manage Server.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

allowList.description: Words that are never matched (keyword and keyword_preset)

mentionLimit.description: mention_spam: max unique mentions per message

customMessage.description: Shown to the member whose message is blocked (implies blockMessage)

alertChannelId.description: Action: post an alert in this channel

timeoutMinutes.description: Action: time the member out (keyword and mention_spam only)

blockMemberInteraction.description: Action: block the member from interacting (member_profile only)

tools.name: edit_automod_rule
tools.description: Change an AutoMod rule (only the fields you pass). Trigger settings you pass replace the same setting of the rule; passing any action field replaces all of the rule's actions. The trigger type cannot change.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

allowList.description: Words that are never matched (keyword and keyword_preset)

mentionLimit.description: mention_spam: max unique mentions per message

customMessage.description: Shown to the member whose message is blocked (implies blockMessage)

alertChannelId.description: Action: post an alert in this channel

timeoutMinutes.description: Action: time the member out (keyword and mention_spam only)

blockMemberInteraction.description: Action: block the member from interacting (member_profile only)

tools.name: delete_automod_rule
tools.description: Delete an AutoMod rule. confirmName must exactly match the rule's current name. Take a snapshot first.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: get_onboarding
tools.description: Show the server's onboarding: on/off, mode, default channels, and every question with its options.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: edit_onboarding
tools.description: Change the server's onboarding (only the fields you pass). prompts replaces ALL questions (read them with get_onboarding first and pass the whole list). Needs the Community feature. Discord requires default channels (several that @everyone can see) before onboarding can be enabled. Needs Manage Server and Manage Roles.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

inOnboarding.description: Ask during onboarding (false = only in Channels & Roles)

tools.name: get_welcome_screen
tools.description: Show the welcome screen: on/off, description and its channels.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: edit_welcome_screen
tools.description: Change the welcome screen (only the fields you pass). welcomeChannels replaces the whole list (up to 5). Needs the Community feature and Manage Server.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: enable_community
tools.description: Turn the Community features on (needed for onboarding, the welcome screen and server discovery). Discord requires a rules channel and a public updates channel (text channels), verification level at least 1 (low) and the explicit content filter set to scan all members; this tool sets what is missing, so verification and the content filter can become stricter. Pass the channel IDs if the server has none set. Defaults to dryRun, which lists what would change. Keeps every feature the server already has. Needs Administrator: the bot must hold it (a server owner can grant it to the bot role), and a real run is refused without it.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

rulesChannelId.description: Text channel for rules. Defaults to the server's current one.

publicUpdatesChannelId.description: Text channel for Discord's notices. Defaults to the server's current one.

tools.name: disable_community
tools.description: Turn the Community features off. Server discovery is removed with it, and the community-only features (onboarding, welcome screen) stop working until it is turned on again. Channels, roles and settings stay. Defaults to dryRun. Needs Administrator.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: list_stickers
tools.description: List custom stickers (ID, name, tags, format).

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: create_sticker
tools.description: Add a custom sticker from a PNG, APNG, GIF or Lottie JSON file (URL or absolute path). Discord limits it to 512 KB and 320x320 px. tags is the emoji name that suggests the sticker (e.g. "wave"). Needs Create Expressions and a server with a free sticker slot.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: delete_sticker
tools.description: Delete a custom sticker.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: check_access
tools.description: Work out what a member or a role can really do, following Discord's rules: server owner and Administrator bypass everything, then @everyone and role permissions, then the channel's overwrites (@everyone, then roles, then the member). Pass userId for a member (their roles, owner status and timeout are looked up; no Server Members Intent needed) or role (name or ID) to test @everyone plus that one role. With channelId it lists the effective permissions in that channel. Without it, it checks `permissions` (default: ViewChannel and SendMessages for text, ViewChannel, Connect and Speak for voice) in every channel. Overwrites on a category are not inherited by its channels here: each channel's own overwrites are what Discord applies, so sync_permissions copies them.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

role.description: A role name or ID, instead of userId

permissions.description: Permission names to check in every channel, e.g. ManageMessages

tools.name: audit_permissions
tools.description: Read-only security review of roles and channel permissions. Reports, most serious first: @everyone or roles that hold Administrator or other powerful permissions (Manage Server/Roles/Channels/Webhooks, Ban/Kick/Timeout, Manage Messages, Mention Everyone, ...), roles that share a name, overwrites pointing at deleted roles, channels made public inside a private category, and whether the bot's role can manage the others. An empty result means nothing was found. Changes nothing.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List LOCAL layout templates: the built-in ones (minimal, gaming, study, creator, support) and any you saved with save_template. They are roles plus channels stored by this tool, not Discord's own server templates (those are list_guild_templates). Use apply_template to build one.

tools.name: save_template
tools.description: Save a LOCAL layout template (roles plus channels) as a JSON file on this computer, in the config folder's templates directory. Not a Discord server template (see create_guild_template). Without categories/roles it copies the current server's roles (without bot-managed roles) and channels. Role names used in permissions must be declared in the roles. Name: lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Overwrites a saved template of the same name; built-in names are refused.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

layout.description: Same shape as apply_layout's categories and uncategorized

tools.name: apply_template
tools.description: Build a LOCAL template (from list_templates) on a server: creates the template's missing roles, then lays out its channels and categories (matched by name; existing ones are kept, nothing is deleted or removed). Safe to repeat: a second run reports nothing to change. Defaults to dryRun; a real run saves a snapshot first. Not the same as Discord's server templates. The bot can only give a role permissions it holds itself, so a template whose roles ask for more is refused before anything changes (use the invite link for all tools). Stage channels need a Community server (enable_community); a real run is refused without it.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: list_guild_templates
tools.description: List DISCORD server templates of this server (the discord.new links people can use to start a new server with this one's channels and roles). Not the local templates of list_templates. A server has at most one. Needs Manage Server.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: get_guild_template
tools.description: Look up any DISCORD server template by its code (the part after discord.new/). Read-only; works for templates of other servers too.

tools.name: create_guild_template
tools.description: Create the DISCORD server template for this server from its current channels and roles (messages and members are not included). Discord allows only one template per server (a second create fails with code 30031): use sync_guild_template to refresh it. Needs the Administrator permission.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: sync_guild_template
tools.description: Update the DISCORD server template to the server's current channels and roles. Needs Manage Server.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: edit_guild_template
tools.description: Change the name or description of the DISCORD server template (not its channels; use sync_guild_template for those). Needs Manage Server.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: delete_guild_template
tools.description: Delete the DISCORD server template. The discord.new link stops working and cannot be restored (create a new one for a new code). confirmName must match the template's current name. Needs Manage Server.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: inactive_channels
tools.description: List text, announcement, forum and media channels with no activity for at least `days` days, longest idle first. It reads each channel's newest message ID, so it costs one request in total and shows no message content. Forum and media channels show their newest post. A channel that never had a message is dated from its creation and marked "never". Voice and stage channels are not judged. Use it to find channels to archive or delete; it deletes nothing.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: activity_report
tools.description: Summarize how active the server is. Always: approximate member and online counts (no intent needed), channel counts, and the most and least recently active channels (from newest message IDs, cheap). With sampleDays set it also reads up to the latest 100 messages in each of at most 25 of the busiest channels and reports message counts and top posters over that period. That sample is capped, so counts in busy channels are lower bounds. Message text is never returned. Needs Read Message History for the sampled channels; channels the bot cannot read are skipped and listed.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

sampleDays.description: Also sample messages from the last N days

top.description: How many channels and posters to list

tools.name: get_stage
tools.description: Show live stages (a stage channel with a running topic). With channelId it checks that one channel; without, it checks every stage channel in the server, one request each, because Discord has no list endpoint. Stage channels with nothing running are listed as not live.

guildId.description: Server (guild) ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID if omitted.

tools.name: start_stage
tools.description: Start a live stage in a stage channel with a topic (1-120 characters). Visible to server members only. Needs Manage Channels, Mute Members and Move Members on the stage channel. notifyEveryone=true pings @everyone and also needs Mention Everyone. Fails if a stage is already running there (use edit_stage).

tools.name: edit_stage
tools.description: Change the topic of a live stage. Needs Manage Channels, Mute Members and Move Members on the stage channel. Fails if no stage is running there.

tools.name: end_stage
tools.description: End a live stage. The channel itself stays. Needs Manage Channels, Mute Members and Move Members on the stage channel. confirmTopic must match the running topic exactly, so the wrong stage is never ended.
